source: git clone https://github.com/Yousifqayssar/gymflow.git (commit e1ba86c) into an empty folder, then only the steps in README.md
adaptation: The developer's own GymFlow database already runs on this computer (container gymflow-db, port 5432). The fresh copy therefore used POSTGRES_PORT=5433 and a one-line docker-compose.override.yml that renames the container to gymflow-db-fresh. Everything else followed the README as published.

steps.actual: 3 files created with new random password, JWT secret and admin password; git status shows none of them
Exit 0; npm reports the 6 known server advisories (see Week 6, 9.3)
HTTP 200; /api requests reach the API through the Vite proxy
6 plans, 2 trainers, 12 members, 25 classes, 145 check-ins, 17 payments, 5 partner gyms, 32 exercises …
